items.title: Unit 6 · Story
items.scene: The ___ has a hot pot.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.spokenScene: The fox has a hot pot.
items.storyText: The fox has a hot pot. He stands on a log and uses a rod. The fish hops. It doesn't like the rod! The fox hops, too. He gets wet!
items.why: In “The Fox”, you hear: The fox has a hot pot. The missing word is “fox”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 2, Unit 6, p.59 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
